findings.current: The moment he heard the Sound Transmission, Jeok Cheongang moved with remarkable speed—and made it look perfectly natural.
findings.defect: The source describes the Sound Transmission as piercing into the listener’s ear. The assembled version reduces that image to simply hearing it, losing a physical detail preserved in the accepted baseline.
findings.rationale: 귓가를 파고든전음 explicitly gives the transmission a penetrating action at the ear; the baseline preserves that image.
findings.replacement: The moment the Sound Transmission pierced his ear, Jeok Cheongang moved with remarkable speed—and made it look perfectly natural.

findings.current: Your severed tongue has finally grown back in the right place.
findings.defect: “Grown back” changes the image from a tongue being reattached to one regrowing. The source says the cut tongue is finally attached back in its proper place.
findings.rationale: 제자리에 붙었군 describes the tongue being attached back in place, not growing back.
findings.replacement: Your severed tongue has finally been put back in its proper place.

summary: The translation is faithful overall, with two minor losses or shifts in source detail.
